C16 is structurally similar but narrower and partly temporary; C09 has an especially close title but no displayed operative language establishing a concrete drafting parallel.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"designation certain officers the department commerce act secretary","parent_excerpt":"the officer whose name is highest on the following list and who is not absent or under disability to discharge the duties of the office of the Secretary of Agriculture shall perform the duties of that office","explanation":"The child's title identifies the same department-specific designation of officers to act as Secretary, while C04 provides the concrete ranked-succession formulation plausibly adapted from Agriculture to Commerce."},{"child_excerpt":"This order supersedes [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of August 18, 1947, entitled \"Designation of the Assistant Secretaries of Commerce and the Solicitor of Commerce to Act as Secretary of Commerce\".","parent_excerpt":"This order supersedes [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of October 6, 1936.","explanation":"Each directive replaces an earlier order governing succession to the relevant cabinet office, reinforcing the parallel administrative structure."}]}
